facts.text: Simultaneous collection from both candidate sensor suites is the strongest end-to-end experiment for comparing the old and new systems.

facts.text: An end-to-end comparison should place both candidate sensor suites on the same machine, preserve their intended mounting geometry as far as practical, and evaluate both against the same independent reference trajectory.

facts.text: Where simultaneous mounting of candidate sensor suites materially alters visibility or electromagnetic or optical behaviour, the mounting interference must itself be tested.
